description: This file is a ucode script used for configuring and managing wireless interface settings, including PHY setup and teardown procedures within the Wi-Fi network configuration in an OpenWRT environment.

methods.name: phy_suffix
methods.description: Generates a suffix string for PHY based on radio index.

methods.name: reset_config
methods.description: Resets the configuration for a given PHY and radio, updating hostapd and wpa_supplicant configurations.

methods.name: get_channel_frequency
methods.description: Calculates the frequency in MHz for a given band and channel number.

methods.name: setup_phy
methods.description: Configures PHY parameters including antenna, power, and frequency settings.

methods.name: iw_htmode
methods.description: Determines the HT mode string based on configuration parameters.

methods.name: config_add
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the configuration if the value is not null.

methods.name: config_add_mesh_params
methods.description: Adds mesh-specific parameters to the configuration.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Main function to set up wireless PHY and interfaces based on configuration data.

methods.name: teardown
methods.description: Main function to tear down/reset wireless PHY based on configuration data.
